t: Remove WAI-Workspace files, temp state files, stray GEMINI.md, and other deprecated artifacts
challenge: 9 WAI-Workspace.* files in reference/auto/_workspace/ directories, 2 temp state files in hub, stray GEMINI.md in hub/WAI-Spoke, and possible other deprecated files clutter the repos.
perceive: 1. find -name 'WAI-Workspace*' across framework. 2. ls hub/WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json.new and .tmp. 3. Confirm hub/WAI-Spoke/GEMINI.md is stray (user confirmed: remove). 4. Scan for other deprecated patterns: .v1-backup files, empty .gitkeep-only dirs that serve no purpose.
execute: 1. rm framework/WAI-Spoke/reference/auto/_workspace/WAI-Workspace.* (3 files). 2. rm framework/reference/v1-data/reference/auto/_workspace/WAI-Workspace.* (3 files). 3. rm framework/test-bench/WAI-Spoke/reference/auto/_workspace/WAI-Workspace.* (3 files). 4. rm hub/WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json.new and .tmp. 5. rm hub/WAI-Spoke/GEMINI.md. 6. Remove empty _workspace/ parent dirs after file removal.
verify: 1. find . -name 'WAI-Workspace*' returns nothing. 2. test ! -f hub/WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json.new. 3. test ! -f hub/WAI-Spoke/GEMINI.md. 4. No empty _workspace/ directories remain.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Remove confirmed deprecated files from framework and hub repos
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not removing reference/v1-data/ itself — that's archived reference data. Only removing the WAI-Workspace files within it.
